codex_technical_acceptance_requires: All L01 checks PASS with evidence; machine results do not replace visual QA

criteria.name: Input source and immutable baseline hashes
Bounded scope
criteria.required_evidence: Only versioned candidate and GLM report change; tracked source snapshot unchanged

criteria.name: Real independently assembled puppet
criteria.required_evidence: Manifest-only assembly; no preview source underlays or disguised copies

criteria.name: Mouthless lower-face quality
criteria.required_evidence: No residual smile/lips, natural receiver, no rectangular concealment

criteria.name: Beard and moustache composition
criteria.required_evidence: Clean skin/beard seam, no skin holes, stable outer jaw, correct moustache

criteria.name: Forehead/hair/diadem intersection
criteria.required_evidence: Continuous coverage, original contour retained, no hard colour seam

criteria.name: Cheek/neck connection
criteria.required_evidence: Smooth joins, no jagged truncation or silhouette breaks

criteria.name: Interior coverage
criteria.required_evidence: Zero new transparent pixels where master visible; zero alpha-below-250 deficits where master alpha>=250; immutable one-pixel eroded domain

criteria.name: Identity and source resemblance
criteria.required_evidence: Source face/hair/diadem/palette preserved; neutral resembles master

criteria.name: Exact exported-alpha masks
criteria.required_evidence: L masks equal exported alpha; selections/provenance separate

criteria.name: Honest reconstruction provenance
criteria.required_evidence: Disjoint source/reconstructed masks within each sprite; exact source RGB claims

criteria.name: Feature alignment
criteria.required_evidence: Original eye/brow pivots and shape relationships preserved

criteria.name: Neutral mouth state
criteria.required_evidence: Actual single-patch composition, no duplicate contour or smile

criteria.name: Small-open test state
criteria.required_evidence: Actual alternate patch, coherent beard and skin, no changed jaw identity

criteria.name: No duplicated features or edge artifacts
criteria.required_evidence: Inspect source scale and 2–4x on light/dark/checker backgrounds

criteria.name: Conservative local-motion stress
criteria.required_evidence: Both patches ±2px XY and moustache ±1px XY remain covered/coherent; no general rig claim

criteria.name: All manifests, pivots, files and paths valid
criteria.required_evidence: Unique IDs, group order, bounds, parents, hashes, previews from actual layers

criteria.name: Required tests and repository gate healthy
criteria.required_evidence: Independent structural result, stress report, git diff check, make check

later_release_gates.requires: Actual independent review report tied to final file hashes
Explicit owner approval tied to final candidate hashes
